{
  "usage": "node-assets tune <input>... --for size|gpu|load|compat[,...] [-o <dir>] [--fidelity 0.9] [--view 1024] [--network 4g] [--amortize N] [--keep hierarchy,texture-size,geometry] [--time-limit 7m]",
  "description": "Search the levers (texture format/quality/size incl. KTX2 modes, geometry quantize/meshopt/draco + options, simplification, dedup/weld/instancing/flattening) for the best result per goal, never going below the fidelity limit. Writes one recipe per input and goal plus a preview image and the full candidate table; does not write models (use `run`).",
  "goals": [
    "size: smallest download, counting decoder downloads (shared across --amortize assets)",
    "gpu: lowest estimated GPU memory (textures + vertex data)",
    "load: fastest load = download time on --network + measured decode time",
    "compat: fewest required glTF extensions (no decoders), then smallest"
  ],
  "limits": [
    "--time-limit: total budget for the whole run (default 7m); the best results found so far are kept when it runs out",
    "--fidelity: worst 64px-region SSIM vs the original over 4 views at --view px (default 0.9 at 1024px, the recommended limit for no visible quality loss)",
    "--network: slow-4g (1.6 Mbps) | 4g (9 Mbps, default) | wifi (30 Mbps)"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "node-assets tune assets/helmet.glb --for size,gpu -o recipes/",
    "node-assets tune assets/*.glb --for load --network slow-4g -o recipes/"
  ]
}

{
  "usage": "node-assets optimize <input>... -o <file.glb|dir/> [lever flags] [--force]",
  "description": "Apply the default recipe (WebP textures <=2048px, quantized geometry, lossless cleanup), with any lever overridden by flags. Several inputs or a directory need -o <dir/>.",
  "flags": [
    "--texture-format keep|webp|avif|jpeg|png|ktx2 (default webp)",
    "--texture-quality 1-100 (default 90; normal/data maps use max(q,95))",
    "--texture-size <px> max texture side (default 2048)",
    "--ktx2 etc1s|uastc|etc1s+uastc (color+data modes when --texture-format ktx2; default etc1s+uastc)",
    "--geometry quantize|meshopt|draco|none (default quantize)",
    "--simplify <ratio> keep this share of triangles, 0.05-1 (default 1)",
    "--meshopt-level medium|high",
    "--keep-hierarchy  do not flatten or instance nodes",
    "-f, --force  replace existing outputs"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "node-assets optimize assets/helmet.glb -o public/models/helmet.glb",
    "node-assets optimize assets/ -o public/models/ --force --geometry meshopt"
  ]
}
